name: Miyahara Yuzuru
source:
Baby-faced and petite.

He was always ridiculed by his childhood friend, Naofumi Sasame, for being quiet and timid. However, one day, he found Sasame's weakness. He uses it as a joke to threaten him and eventually start sexually harassing him.
